summary: Implemented Admin backend log clearing for allowed current log files and numeric archives, with route integration, failure reporting, authentication-boundary coverage, and readLogs compatibility coverage preserved.
notes: clearLogs defaults to targeting only dataDir/logs for walker.out.log, walker.err.log, walker.log, walker-out.log, walker-err.log and numeric archives such as .1.
POST /api/admin/logs/clear now matches GET /api/admin/logs fallback behavior: when fallbackToCwd is enabled and dataDir differs from cwd, it also clears project-root cwd/logs.
Current log files are truncated to 0 bytes; numeric archives are deleted; missing files and missing logs directory are treated as success.
Non-log files such as logs/keep.txt and files outside logs are not touched.
Partial filesystem failures produce ok=false with failures entries; the route returns HTTP 500 with the same failure list in response data.
The route relies on existing Admin route registration authGuard; tests cover that an unauthorized guarded request does not execute clearing.
readLogs remains limited to current runtime/legacy log files and does not read numeric archives.
